craft_notes: Sthāyin: never-separately (#3 never-separately with v95/105: the refrain of inseparability: wherever power-shake, woman-nature IS — never apart). Rows: row 3 (woman-nature→never separately). Close: made (kṛtam — never MADE separately: separateness is manufacture, not fact). Rejected: 'feminine principle' theology — killed: woman-nature kept (strītva as the text's own word); 'Shakti exists' technical — kept power-shaking where-not-power (the conditional structure: SHAKE marks her).

lines: Anywhere power shaking, where not power, ego-free:
l4.sanskrit_cite: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca samo mānāvamānayoḥ || brahmaṇaḥ paripūrṇatvāt iti jñātvā sukhī bhavet

reads_against.argmap: How should enemy and friend stand? → Brahma's fullness known, all pairs equal — happiness follows.
c1_essence: Enemy same as friend, honor same as dishonor: happy.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra with śānta undertow (resolve laid quiet)
